method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: search_auction_vehicles
tools.title: Search auction vehicles
tools.description: Use for broad inventory discovery, filtering and incremental synchronization across supported Copart and IAA / IAAI records. For one known VIN or lot use get_vehicle; for retained auction appearances use get_vehicle_history.

s.description: Search by VIN, lot number or vehicle title/model text.

lot_status.description: Auction mode filter: All, Timed or Buy Now.

lot_sub_status.description: Normalized auction state: Open for active/open lots, Live for currently live supported lots, Ended for closed/ended lots.

upcoming.description: Upcoming selector: all=no upcoming restriction, only=upcoming eligible lots only, without=exclude upcoming lots.

auction_type.description: Numeric compatibility source selector: 0=all, 1=Copart, 2=IAAI. If both auction_type and platform are supplied, auction_type takes precedence; prefer platform for new integrations.

platform.description: Readable auction-source selector: copart or iaai. Omit for combined supported sources.

body_style.description: Filter by vehicle_specs.body_style. A string or array is accepted; multiple values are OR-ed. IAAI uses VehicleClass and Copart uses the source-backed Body Style field.

body_type.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for body_style. A string or array is accepted; prefer body_style for new integrations.

series.description: Series / model family filter for GET /vehicles.

engine_size_from.description: Engine size from filter for GET /vehicles.

engine_size_to.description: Engine size to filter for GET /vehicles.

has_key.description: Key-availability filter using the documented values No, All or With.

updated_within_minutes.description: Incremental-sync window. Return records whose updated_at changed within this many minutes; supported range is 1..525600. Use with cursor pagination and an overlap window.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the API. Send next_cursor back unchanged; do not decode or synthesize it.

zip.description: ZIP/postal code used with radius for supported proximity search.

radius.description: Search radius around zip, interpreted using the selected units.

units.description: Distance and odometer unit system: mi or km.

per_page.description: Requested page size. Effective maximum is subscription-plan dependent; common public plan limits are 20, 30 or 40 and custom plans may differ.

include_total.description: Include exact total filter for GET /vehicles.

facility_id.description: Auction facility identifier used to restrict results to one supported facility.

loc_state.description: Auction location state or region, for example FL.

office_name.description: Auction office or branch name filter.

auction_date_from.description: Start auction date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

auction_date_to.description: End auction date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

today_only.description: When true, restrict results to the endpoint current-day auction logic.

sale_document_pending.description: When true, restrict results to records with a pending sale document state when supported.

sale_document_type.description: Sale/title document type filter; values are source-backed and can vary.

seller_type.description: Normalized seller type: dealer, finance, insurance or non_insurance.

has_shipping_price.description: When true, return only vehicles with supported shipping-price data.

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON returned by the canonical Apibara Vehicle Auction Data API. Source-dependent fields may be null or absent.

meta.description: Pagination metadata. Treat cursor values as opaque.

tools.name: get_vehicle
tools.title: Get vehicle
tools.description: Use when the user already has a VIN, lot number or supported slug and needs the current normalized vehicle record. Request include history and/or vin_lots when the same tool call should also return retained sale history or other known auction lots for the same VIN.

identifier.description: VIN, lot number or slug_vin accepted by the canonical vehicle detail endpoint.

include.description: Optional related data to embed in the vehicle detail result.

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON returned by the canonical Apibara Vehicle Auction Data API. Source-dependent fields may be null or absent.

tools.name: get_vehicle_history
tools.title: Get vehicle auction history
tools.description: Use for retained Copart + IAAI auction appearances for one supported vehicle. This is auction-specific history, not complete ownership, registration or accident history.

identifier.description: VIN, lot number or slug_vin accepted by the canonical vehicle detail endpoint.

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON returned by the canonical Apibara Vehicle Auction Data API. Source-dependent fields may be null or absent.

meta.description: Pagination metadata. Treat cursor values as opaque.

tools.name: get_related_vehicles
tools.title: Get related vehicles
tools.description: Use after identifying a specific vehicle to retrieve related supported auction records for comparison or discovery. Do not use as a substitute for a broad filtered inventory search.

identifier.description: VIN, lot number or slug_vin accepted by the canonical vehicle detail endpoint.

per_page.description: Maximum related records to return. Effective limits are plan-dependent.

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON returned by the canonical Apibara Vehicle Auction Data API. Source-dependent fields may be null or absent.

meta.description: Pagination metadata. Treat cursor values as opaque.

tools.name: get_vehicle_filters
tools.title: Get vehicle filters
tools.description: Use before building a dynamic search UI or validating source-backed filter choices. Returns current filter metadata; it does not search inventory itself.

platform.description: Optional readable auction-source selector. Omit to retrieve combined supported filter metadata.

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON returned by the canonical Apibara Vehicle Auction Data API. Source-dependent fields may be null or absent.

tools.name: list_auction_locations
tools.title: List auction locations
tools.description: Use to resolve supported auction yards, branches or facilities and their location metadata. Use calculate_shipping when the user needs auction-to-port pricing instead.

platform.description: Optional source selector: Copart or IAA / IAAI.

s.description: Free-text location search, such as a facility name, city or supported location term.

country.description: Optional country filter supported by the locations endpoint.

state.description: Optional state or region filter, for example FL.

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON returned by the canonical Apibara Vehicle Auction Data API. Source-dependent fields may be null or absent.

meta.description: Pagination metadata. Treat cursor values as opaque.

tools.name: calculate_shipping
tools.title: Calculate auction-to-port shipping
tools.description: Use when the user asks for supported auction-to-port shipping pricing for a known vehicle. Supply either VIN or lot_number; optionally narrow the destination with port or port_id. Availability depends on auction location and route data.

vin.description: Vehicle Identification Number. Provide this or lot_number.

lot_number.description: Auction lot number. Provide this or vin.

port.description: Optional destination port name supported by the shipping endpoint.

port_id.description: Optional destination port identifier when known.

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON returned by the canonical Apibara Vehicle Auction Data API. Source-dependent fields may be null or absent.

tools.name: get_api_usage
tools.title: Get API usage
tools.description: Use to inspect request usage and current plan limits for the supplied X-API-Key. This is account/API-quota metadata, not vehicle data.

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON returned by the canonical Apibara Vehicle Auction Data API. Source-dependent fields may be null or absent.
